title: TFL Template Metadata v2.4 — Complete Source Extraction Pack
description: Source-template extraction contract v2.4. One physical source shell per DOCX. Source occurrences and their relations are independent of optional future adaptation rules. No automatic layout expansion, merge, target generation or mandatory replacement test.

template_id.description: Stable key; does not change if document is renamed

output_type.description: Source-declared TFL output type; determines archival folder and historical number. May differ from structural_family.

file_path.description: Path relative to TFL_Template_Library directory, e.g. table/TBL_S01_001.docx

structural_family.description: Actual structural layout used for parsing and metadata specification; does not change source TFL type.

retrieval_text.description: Short validated description for keyword/BM25 ranking and human or LLM candidate review; not an embedding requirement.

editable_elements.description: Optional future rules. Source locators and occurrences live only in source_elements; do not duplicate them here. Leave [] during extraction.

basis_ref_id.description: Must cite style guide or approved convention

adaptation.description: Reserved future-stage information. All arrays may remain empty for extraction; no target adaptation or target-field validation is required now.

display_order.description: 0-based physical order of distinct footnotes within this source shell

items.description: Typed link from source footnote marker to visible shell element; a missing association is unresolved, never guessed.

target_id.description: row/column/panel ID; cell uses row_id:column_id; axis uses panel_id:x or panel_id:y; null for shell/unknown.

applies_to_refs.description: Typed footnote marker-to-row/column/cell/panel associations; [] requires a review issue unless truly global.

semantic_extraction_status.description: extracted includes abbreviation and display conventions as well as statistical rules; no_rule_identified requires explicit inspection, not merely an empty array.

semantic_rules.description: One note may express multiple independent semantic rules; rule scopes inherit footnote applies_to_refs unless overridden.

normalized_rule.description: Faithful paraphrase of source rule, not a default for target studies; null if unresolved.

adaptation_field.description: The target-SAP requirement to check before adapting; not an unverified target Specification JSON Pointer.

items.description: Typed link from source footnote marker to visible shell element; a missing association is unresolved, never guessed.

target_id.description: row/column/panel ID; cell uses row_id:column_id; axis uses panel_id:x or panel_id:y; null for shell/unknown.

applies_to_refs.description: Optional narrower rule scope; if omitted, inherit the footnote scope.

evidence_ref_ids.description: Links to source_shell evidence; cross-validated against provenance.evidence.

source_record_id.description: Stem of Source_Records/<template_id>.json, if available. Does not imply that the record was semantically reviewed.

source_regions.description: Optional PDF-area coordinates linked to this evidence. PDF page numbers start at 1.

json_pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the template object; may reference a whole array

items.description: Preserve source spellings; e.g. n (%), mean (SD)

denominator_rule.description: Optional general source-summary only. Multiple row/cell-specific denominators MUST be captured in footnotes[].semantic_rules and applies_to_refs; do not overwrite with one global string.

panels.description: Physical panels of one source output; may repeat logical column IDs. Not a template-family reuse link.

row_ids.description: IDs from intermediate/Structured_Shells/<template_id>.json, not assumed to exist in listing_spec. Resolve in that persisted record; missing record or target is a QA issue.

panels.description: Physical panels of one source output; may repeat logical column IDs. Not a template-family reuse link.

row_ids.description: IDs from intermediate/Structured_Shells/<template_id>.json, not assumed to exist in listing_spec. Resolve in that persisted record; missing record or target is a QA issue.

field_statuses.description: Field-level assertion states. An empty array means no assertions were added yet, not that every field was reviewed.

json_pointer.description: JSON Pointer to an existing field in this template.

docx_boundary.description: Names identify two real, collapsed Word bookmarks. Range begins before the first owned source content (study/date heading or title) and ends after all owned panels, footnotes, source lines, placeholders and programming notes. Exclude QA commentary. Actual order, containment and hash require DOCX validation; schema validity alone does not verify them.

source_elements.description: Logical source elements, including observations not yet designated editable. Membership in one element must be justified semantically, never by equal strings alone. IDs are unique within template. Actual visible content must be covered; empty arrays require explicit pending/coverage issue.

metadata_pointer.description: Pointer within this template to the corresponding source fact.

docx_locator.description: Real bookmark/content-control locator; null for an unlocated/noneditable occurrence.

source_text.description: Verbatim text of this occurrence. Null only when unreadable/nontextual, with an issue.

occurrence_relations.description: Within-template observations only. No replacement or synchronization is triggered. exact_repeat requires identical source text; text variants affecting meaning remain distinct elements.
